_comment: Frozen RFC-0007 §10 port debt. The gate fails if any count RISES; lower it by fixing violations, then re-run --write-baseline. Every entry must carry a reason and a phase in the migration playbook.
_notes:
Empty. Every control in controls/service-ports.yaml is enforced at zero.

SP-0007 closed 2026-08-31, from 321 when it was first frozen. The last 24 entries went only after the images that stopped reading them reached all four environments: call-routing-service, org-service and order-service now resolve every upstream by logical name through the servicediscovery registry. Deleting a manifest entry before its image is everywhere drops the running process to a localhost default in-cluster, which is RFC-0007 §11 atomicity and the shape of the HTTP_PORT outage.

An empty controls map is the state to keep. A number here is debt with a note attached; the note is what stops it becoming permanent.
